name: Mini VPS (Linux)
author: mistersuki@proton.me
description: A small isolated Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine or Arch) inside a server: you are root in it and type its commands in the Console (apt install...). It runs with PRoot, without any right on the machine.
startup: if [ -f ./vps-start.sh ]; then bash ./vps-start.sh; else echo "The mini VPS is not installed: reinstall the server from the Settings tab."; exit 1; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installs the mini VPS: writes its start script first, then installs PRoot and the Linux system with it. Everything
# is written in vps-install.log; if something fails here, the server tries again when it starts and shows the log.
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

main() {
    echo "Installation of the mini VPS - $(date -u)"
    apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "apt-get update failed (no network for the installation?)"
    apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates xz-utils tar >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "curl / xz could not be installed"

    cat > /mnt/server/vps-start.sh <<'START'
#!/bin/bash
# The mini VPS: the Linux system in rootfs/, entered with PRoot (you are "root" in it, without any right on the
# machine). Type your commands in the Console of the panel.
BASE="${VPS_BASE:-/home/container}"
cd "$BASE" || exit 1
ROOT="$BASE/rootfs"

install_system() {
    case "$(uname -m)" in
        x86_64 | amd64) ARCH=amd64 ;;
        aarch64 | arm64) ARCH=arm64 ;;
        *) echo "The mini VPS is only offered on x86_64 and arm64 machines."; return 1 ;;
    esac
    for tool in curl tar; do
        command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The program $tool is missing: reinstall the server from the Settings tab."; return 1; }
    done
    # Everything is downloaded in the folder of the server: /tmp is small (100 MB on Wings).
    WORK="$BASE/.vps-install"
    rm -rf "$WORK"
    mkdir -p "$WORK"
    export TMPDIR="$WORK"

    if [ ! -x "$BASE/proot" ]; then
        echo "Downloading PRoot..."
        if [ "$ARCH" = "amd64" ]; then
            curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$BASE/proot" https://github.com/proot-me/proot/releases/download/v5.5.0/proot \
                || curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$BASE/proot" https://proot.gitlab.io/proot/bin/proot \
                || { echo "PRoot could not be downloaded (GitHub and GitLab did not answer)."; rm -rf "$WORK"; return 1; }
        elif command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ]; then
            apt-get install -y -qq proot >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "PRoot could not be installed."; rm -rf "$WORK"; return 1; }
            cp "$(command -v proot)" "$BASE/proot"
            mkdir -p "$BASE/lib"
            for library in $(ldd "$(command -v proot)" | grep -o '/[^ ]*libtalloc[^ ]*'); do cp -L "$library" "$BASE/lib/"; done
        else
            echo "On arm64, PRoot is installed by the installation: reinstall the server from the Settings tab."
            rm -rf "$WORK"
            return 1
        fi
        chmod +x "$BASE/proot"
    fi

    if [ "${VPS_RESET:-0}" = "1" ] && [ "$1" = "reset" ]; then
        echo "Deleting the old Linux system (Start again from a new system = 1)..."
        rm -rf "$ROOT"
    fi
    if [ ! -d "$ROOT/usr" ]; then
        command -v xz >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "The program xz is missing to unpack the system: reinstall the server from the Settings tab."; rm -rf "$WORK"; return 1; }
        DISTRO="${VPS_DISTRO:-debian/bookworm}"
        NAME="${DISTRO%%/*}"
        RELEASE="${DISTRO##*/}"
        LINE=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://images.linuxcontainers.org/meta/1.0/index-system | grep "^${NAME};${RELEASE};${ARCH};default;" | tail -n 1)
        DIR=$(echo "$LINE" | cut -d';' -f6)
        if [ -z "$DIR" ]; then
            echo "The system ${DISTRO} (${ARCH}) could not be found on images.linuxcontainers.org."
            rm -rf "$WORK"
            return 1
        fi
        echo "Downloading ${NAME} ${RELEASE} (${ARCH}), about 100 MB..."
        if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$WORK/rootfs.tar.xz" "https://images.linuxcontainers.org${DIR}rootfs.tar.xz"; then
            echo "The download failed: check that the server has at least 1 GB of disk."
            rm -rf "$WORK"
            return 1
        fi
        echo "Unpacking the system..."
        rm -rf "$ROOT"
        mkdir -p "$ROOT"
        if ! tar -xJf "$WORK/rootfs.tar.xz" -C "$ROOT" --exclude='./dev/*' --exclude='dev/*' 2>"$WORK/tar.log"; then
            if [ ! -d "$ROOT/usr" ]; then
                echo "The system could not be unpacked:"
                tail -n 5 "$WORK/tar.log"
                rm -rf "$WORK"
                return 1
            fi
        fi
        mkdir -p "$ROOT/dev" "$ROOT/proc" "$ROOT/sys" "$ROOT/root" "$ROOT/tmp"
        chmod 1777 "$ROOT/tmp" 2>/dev/null || true
        echo "mini-vps" > "$ROOT/etc/hostname"
    fi
    rm -rf "$WORK"
    echo "The Linux system is installed."
}

if [ "$1" = "install" ]; then
    install_system reset
    exit $?
fi

if [ ! -x "$BASE/proot" ] || [ ! -d "$ROOT/usr" ]; then
    echo "The Linux system is not installed yet: it is installed now (a few minutes)."
    if ! install_system; then
        if [ -s "$BASE/vps-install.log" ]; then
            echo "--- End of the log of the installation (vps-install.log) ---"
            tail -n 15 "$BASE/vps-install.log"
        fi
        exit 1
    fi
fi

# The DNS of the machine, so that apt / apk / pacman can download.
if [ -s /etc/resolv.conf ]; then
    cat /etc/resolv.conf > "$ROOT/etc/resolv.conf" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
grep -q nameserver "$ROOT/etc/resolv.conf" 2>/dev/null || echo "nameserver 1.1.1.1" > "$ROOT/etc/resolv.conf"
SYSTEM=$(. "$ROOT/etc/os-release" 2>/dev/null; echo "${PRETTY_NAME:-Linux}")
SHELL_BIN=/bin/bash
[ -x "$ROOT/bin/bash" ] || [ -x "$ROOT/usr/bin/bash" ] || SHELL_BIN=/bin/sh
echo "Mini VPS ready: ${SYSTEM}"
echo "Type Linux commands here: you are root in this system (apt, apk or pacman to install programs)."
echo "Its files: Files tab or SFTP, folder rootfs/. Port of the server: ${SERVER_PORT:-?} (more ports in the Network tab)."
echo "Type exit, or use Stop, to stop it."
export PROOT_NO_SECCOMP=1
export PROOT_TMP_DIR="$BASE/.proot-tmp"
mkdir -p "$PROOT_TMP_DIR"
[ -d "$BASE/lib" ] && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$BASE/lib"
exec "$BASE/proot" -0 -r "$ROOT" -b /dev -b /proc -b /sys -w /root \
    /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/root USER=root LOGNAME=root TERM=xterm LANG=C.UTF-8 \
    PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin \
    SERVER_PORT="${SERVER_PORT}" SERVER_IP="${SERVER_IP}" \
    "$SHELL_BIN" -i
START
    chmod +x /mnt/server/vps-start.sh

    if VPS_BASE=/mnt/server bash /mnt/server/vps-start.sh install; then
        echo "Done: the mini VPS is installed. Start it, then type your commands in the Console."
    else
        echo "The Linux system was not installed now: the server tries again when it starts."
    fi
}

main 2>&1 | tee /mnt/server/vps-install.log
chown -R 988:988 /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
exit 0

variables.name: Linux system
variables.description: The system of the mini VPS. Changing it only applies after a reinstall with "Start again from a new system" set to 1 (the files of the old system are then deleted).

variables.name: Start again from a new system
variables.description: 1: the next reinstall deletes the Linux system (programs and files of rootfs/) and installs a new one. 0: a reinstall keeps it.
